# opnsense_acme_account (Resource)

Manages an os-acme-client account while keeping its generated private account key on OPNsense. Registration is an explicit lifecycle action controlled by `register` and `registration_version`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `ca` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `register` (Boolean)
- `registration_version` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `registered` (Boolean)
- `status_code` (String)
- `status_last_update` (String)
